label: Teltonika RUT271
description: Compact industrial RedCap 5G router: two 10/100 RJ45 ports, Wi-Fi, dual-SIM with eSIM support.
notes: Vendor figures from the Teltonika product page: **two 10/100 RJ45 ports**, RedCap 5G with SA/NSA support, Wi-Fi, dual-SIM. Two things matter: **RedCap 5G is the reduced-capability profile**, not full 5G NR, so its ceiling sits well below a full-NR router; and the **ports are fast Ethernet, not gigabit**, which caps anything wired through it at 100 Mbps regardless of what the cellular side negotiates.
